design_text: Once upon a time, a little goat lived by a big blue lake. Every morning he looked at the water and smiled.

voices.narA: A warm, gentle young adult woman storyteller with a soft, smooth, calm voice, clear American English, like reading a picture book to young children
voices.narB: A bright, cheerful young American woman English teacher with a clear, crisp voice and very careful pronunciation of every vowel, friendly and lively
voices.narC: A friendly, warm American man storyteller in his thirties with a gentle medium voice, relaxed, kind and very clear

pace: slow, clear and careful pronunciation for children learning phonics, every word pronounced fully
